entities.title: zazzle MCP proxy
entities.summary: `zazzled proxy` (reached as `zazzle proxy`): an MCP proxy that sits between a client and another MCP server and shrinks the text of tool results and resource reads with clean's steps.
entities.purpose: mod.rs parses the proxy's command line, records which client requests are tools/call or resources/read by JSON-RPC id (Pending), and rewrites the server's answers to them (Filter): the `text` of `content` items and embedded resources in tool results, and of `contents` in resource reads, each replaced by its cleaned form when that saves at least one token, with the lossless, budget and skip settings the --config file gives that tool or resource reads, else the command line's. Each shortened text is stored with its original in the output store (src/outputs.rs), and an item naming its id is appended after the result's items. config.rs reads and checks the --config file and finds a tool's rule. stdio.rs runs the server as a child and relays newline-delimited messages both ways; http.rs listens on a local TCP address and forwards each Streamable HTTP request to an upstream URL, keeping client connections open for further requests, cleaning JSON bodies whole and event streams event by event.
boundaries: Runs as its own process in the caller's environment, never inside the daemon: the invoker execs `zazzled proxy` (macos/c/zazzle/src/zazzle_core.h exec_daemon), and the daemon's dispatcher refuses `proxy`.

The cleaning itself is clean's (macos/rust/zazzled/src/cmd/clean.rs shrink_steps), and the store is src/outputs.rs; this folder decides what is cleaned, with which settings, and how the stored id is shown.
Requests, protocol messages, errors, structuredContent and non-text items pass through unchanged.
